audit.whatIsWrong: The mirror flagged this chart conflict and left it. Packet levelChart reads Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, and all seven whys describe exactly that; the stored sides read Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Skill, Cassiopeia, Skill, Cassiopeia. Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 print a side that contradicts the sentence beside them — whys[0] says 'Level 1 is yours' under a row labelled Cassiopeia rated 2/10.
audit.why: The prose and the packet agree with each other, and with a 53.81% Warwick win rate over 210 games; the sides are the corrupted layer. Both layers already agree with each other, so this is a chart error, not a layer split.
audit.corrected: Rows set to the packet chart in both layers as one atomic group, ratings re-keyed (early rows to Warwick, 4-5 onward to Cassiopeia). The whys then need no rewrite.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns given for the two abilities the lane turns on.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — a long, countable window, and the only reason her zoning holds. Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 24s Miasma written into spikes[0] and mid; 120s Petrifying Gaze into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: THREE mechanical errors. (1) 'her W Miasma roots your movement' — Miasma grounds, it does not root; you can walk out, you just cannot dash. (2) The entry never states that grounding kills BOTH of your dashes — Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress — which is the whole matchup. (3) 'Petrifying Gaze face-stuns and cancels your Infinite Duress' is stated as unconditional, when Riot's text stuns only enemies facing her and merely slows those with their back turned. Plus the standard 'Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter'.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' Riot's R text distinguishes facing from back-turned. Warwick's Q and R both carry the dash flag, so one Miasma disables his engage and his escape at once.
audit.corrected: Grounding named correctly and stated to disable both dashes; the facing condition on Petrifying Gaze written in; R restated as a directional collision leap.
sources: champ-data/_kits/warwick.json (Q and R dash flags, R text)

edits.before: Once Cassiopeia has her Q poison and W grounding online she zones you hard; her W Miasma roots your movement and shuts off your gap-close, so close through minions before she can lay the grounding zone.
edits.after: Miasma grounds rather than roots: you can still walk, but Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress are both dead inside it — 24s at rank 1, so step in only once she has laid it and left it.

edits.before: Her R Petrifying Gaze plus W grounding stops your R Infinite Duress cold — if you're facing her when she ults you're stunned mid-engage, so approach from her flank or after she uses W.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — turn your back and it is a slow instead. Approach after Miasma is spent, because grounding, not the stun, is what kills your leap.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 belong to Cassiopeia: her W Miasma grounds your dash and her R Petrifying Gaze face-stuns your Infinite Duress, so you can't engage cleanly unless she's already used W.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 belong to Cassiopeia: Miasma grounds both your dashes and is 24s at rank 1, and Petrifying Gaze stuns you only while you face her — engage after she has spent W.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cassiopeia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it hits — but Miasma grounds it. Petrifying Gaze at 120s changes the math too.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Cassiopeia carry threat: 9/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with, and grounding shuts it off — build around that. Cassiopeia carry threat: 9/10 — play picks if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Q-bite Cassiopeia as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Cassiopeia as she steps up, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger heal you once you are under 50% health.

notes: Third matchup with a corrupted level chart — the mirror had already flagged this one and deferred it. Here both layers agree with each other but disagree with the packet AND with all seven of the entry's own whys, so the whys were the surviving correct copy; set the sides to the packet. Killed the 'Miasma roots you' error: it grounds, which is worse and more specific — it disables Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress simultaneously, and the entry never said so. Also corrected Petrifying Gaze, which stuns only enemies facing her. Not asserted (not in the kit data): whether the suppression can be cleansed or QSS'd, and whether Petrifying Gaze can interrupt Infinite Duress after it has connected.
